events.content:
Clean. Here's a summary of the change: **How it works now:** - `lib/catalog-store.ts` — a client-side module cache keyed by category, storing `{ heading, products }`. `prefetchCategory()` kicks off the fetch without waiting; `ensureCategory()`/`getCachedCategory()` read it back. - `app/page.tsx` — now a client component; on mount it calls `prefetchCategory('featured')` and `prefetchCategory('sale')`, so both category links have their heading+products warmed in memory before any click happens. The `href`s are unchanged (`/catalog?category=...`). - `app/catalog/page.tsx` — trimmed to a static shell (`

Catalog

` + `Suspense`) with no server-side data dependency, so the route itself has nothing to render dynamically per request. - `app/catalog/category-results.tsx` — new client component reading `category` via `useSearchParams()` and the cache via `useSyncExternalStore`. If the entry is already warmed (the normal case, coming from the home page), it renders immediately — no server round-trip, no loading flash. If someone hits the URL directly with a cold cache (e.g. pasting the link), it falls back to fetching on the spot and shows "Loading category..." only in that case. Verified with `tsc --noEmit` and `next build` (route now builds as fully static ○), and a dev-server smoke check confirmed a cold direct request to `/catalog?category=sale` still returns correctly.
